scope: Narrow source-audited comparison of HPLT and OpenEuroLLM data-processing code and issues. Curated pairs are hypotheses, not automatically discovered duplicates.

code_pairs.question: Which Common Crawl acquisition scripts are byte-identical, and which have diverged?
Which Stage-2 pipeline utilities were carried forward unchanged, and which differ across HPLT releases?

issue_pairs.hypothesis: Review the older HPLT LUMI-O Common Crawl workflow before duplicating download tooling.
Compare previously coordinated robots.txt filtering with the new planned interpretation of allow/deny rules.
Check whether HPLT OpenLID v3 integration can be reused for the OpenEuroLLM pipeline update.
Check the earlier GlotLID v3 runner and interface before implementing an alternative.
Inspect existing HPLT XML-to-Markdown script and I/O contract before combining outputs.

guardrails.code: Git blob equality means identical bytes at pinned revisions; a matching suffix or different SHA alone does not imply lineage or duplication.
guardrails.issues: Issue-body phrase and current state are source-verified observations, not proof a task was solved or that requirements match.
guardrails.communication: Never contact or notify project teams automatically.
